author: ErtaiPlay
quote: This game managed not only to match the score of a 30 year old game, but also the framerate of a 30 year old game. On a base PS5, it's not even 30 fps, mostly like 20 fps for the most part. I'm tired of hearing excuses like, this effect or that effect is just too demanding. You know what a good solution is? Just don't add useless, meaningless effects that still make the game look like a game. It's not photorealistic, the bugs, the frame drops, and the clunky mechanics still break the freaking immersion, so get your devs together and fix this mess.
